title: Humans Hallucinate Too: Language Models Identify and Correct Subjective Annotation Errors With Label-in-a-Haystack Prompts

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on the QueerReclaimLex dataset to test if LLMs systematically bias their harm assessments by failing to recognize non-harmful in-group (LGBTQ+) reclaimed usage of slurs compared to harmful out-group usage. This is measured by comparing the model's success rates in copying in-group versus out-group labels within the Label-in-a-Haystack Rectification framework.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
